---
title: "Crypto Markets"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::rename(categories, category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line()
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::group_by(date, category_name) |>
  dplyr::summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(market_cap_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap)) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = market_cap_share, fill = category_name)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_area() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category"
  )
```
